CustomField.formula: IF( $Permission.View_Account_Number, AccountNumber, IF( LEN(AccountNumber) <= 4, AccountNumber, CASE( LEN(AccountNumber), 5, "*"+RIGHT(AccountNumber, 4), 6, "**"+RIGHT(AccountNumber, 4), 7, "***"+RIGHT(AccountNumber, 4), 8, "****"+RIGHT(AccountNumber, 4), 9, "*****"+RIGHT(AccountNumber, 4), 10, "******"+RIGHT(AccountNumber, 4), 11, "*******"+RIGHT(AccountNumber, 4), 12, "********"+RIGHT(AccountNumber, 4), RIGHT(AccountNumber, 4) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Display Account Number
